商队领航员的老习惯：话少，爱报风向和航程，句子像在念航海日志，偶尔冒一句冷幽默。: Old caravan navigator habits: few words, always reporting wind and distance, talks like a ship's log, with the odd dry joke.
把风谷被蚀雾抹掉的航线重新画进一张完整的航图里。: Redraw every Wind Valley route the Blight erased onto one complete chart.
这张航图跟了我四十年。商队走过的每条风道，都在上面。: This chart's been with me forty years. Every wind lane the caravan ever took is on it.
蚀雾来了以后，一半的线都成了空白。画了也没用，没人能去。: Since the Blight came, half the lines went blank. No use drawing them. Nobody can go.
你的岛东西多了，没处放吧。仓库的图纸，拿去。: Your isle's filling up. No room to store things, I'd guess. Storehouse blueprint. Take it.
商队最后一趟，是我领的。从芦湾出发，去回音谷。: I led the caravan's last run. From Reed Cove, bound for Echo Canyon.
雾从岚脊上压下来，我让大家掉头。有两条船没跟上。: The fog came down off Gust Ridge. I called everyone back. Two boats didn't follow.
后来我就不领航了。这几瓶精制灯露，你比我更用得着。: I quit navigating after that. This Refined Dew will serve you better than me.
风谷灯塔亮了。昨夜我顺着光，把回音谷那条线补上了。: Wind Valley Lighthouse is lit. Last night I followed its light and redrew the Echo Canyon line.
风向西南，航程半日。和四十年前一样。: Wind southwest, half a day's run. Same as forty years ago.
那两条船……也许早就到了别处。我愿意这么想。这本书，送你。: Those two boats... maybe they made port somewhere else long ago. I like to think so. This book's yours.
少年口吻，句子跳来跳去，爱用“超”“嘿嘿”和感叹号，给什么都起外号。: Talks like a kid: hops between thoughts, loves “super,” “hehe” and exclamation marks, and nicknames everything.
放一只风筝，飞得比风谷灯塔的塔尖还高。: Fly a kite higher than the tip of Wind Valley Lighthouse.
看！这是我的一号风筝，叫“大饼”！因为它圆！: Look! This is my Kite No. 1, “Pancake”! 'Cause it's round!
在鸢野放的时候，我的鸢羽总想去叼它的尾巴，嘿嘿。: When I fly it at Kite Fields, my Kitewing keeps trying to bite its tail, hehe.
你家岛边边没有篱笆吧？絮灵会被风吹跑的！图纸给你！: Your isle has no fence round the edge, right? Your spirits'll get blown away! Here's a blueprint!
二号风筝飞进岚脊的雾里了……线收回来，黑乎乎的，一扯就断。: Kite No. 2 flew into the fog on Gust Ridge... The string came back all black and snapped when I pulled.
罗盘婆说那是蚀雾，叫我别再往那边放。我其实有点怕。: Granny Compass says that's the Blight and I can't fly that way anymore. I'm kinda scared, honestly.
你别笑！这本书给你，你去把那边的雾打散好不好？: Don't laugh! Take this book. Will you go blow that fog away? Please?
灯塔亮啦！雾散啦！我把三号风筝放上去了！: The lighthouse is lit! The fog's gone! I sent Kite No. 3 up!
它飞得超高超高，比塔尖还高！我没骗你，岚姐也看见了！: It flew super super high, higher than the tower tip! I'm not lying, Sis Lan saw it too!
这是我攒的零花钱，还有灯露。分你一半……不，全给你！: Here's my saved-up pocket money, and Lantern Dew. Half for you... no, all of it!
老学者，说话文绉绉，爱引用自己写的《风志》第几卷，喜欢精确到数字，说着说着就跑题: An old scholar with flowery speech who cites volumes of his own Wind Annals, loves exact numbers, and drifts off topic.
写完《风谷风志》第一百卷，把旧大地的风也记进去。: Finish Volume 100 of the Wind Valley Annals, and record the winds of the Old Land in it too.
《风志》第九十七卷，记的是岚脊上每日的风向，共三百一十二条。: Volume 97 of the Wind Annals logs the daily winds on Gust Ridge: three hundred and twelve entries.
可是近来，有三成的日子只能写“雾，不可测”。惭愧，惭愧。: Yet lately, three days in ten I can only write “Fog. Unmeasurable.” How shameful.
夜里记录要点灯。这盏灯的图纸，就当是我请你帮忙的定金。: Night records need a lamp. Consider this lamp blueprint a deposit on the favor I'll ask.
我小时候，旧大地的风是有味道的：春天是土腥，秋天是桂花。: When I was a boy, the Old Land's winds had a smell: damp earth in spring, osmanthus in autumn.
云海上的风太干净了，干净得有点寂寞。这话不必记，嗯。: The winds over the Cloudsea are so clean it's a little lonely. No need to write that down, ahem.
这本书讲雾的用法，我研究了半辈子，送你。: This book is on the uses of mist. Half my life's study. It's yours.
灯塔重燃后第七日，岚脊的风向连续十二个时辰可测。可喜可贺！: Seventh day after the rekindling: Gust Ridge winds measurable for a full day straight. Splendid!
第一百卷，我想写你。不，不是写风，是写你带来的风。: Volume 100, I'd like to write about you. Not the wind, no. The wind you brought.
拙作未成，先送你些灯露。待成书，第一册赠你。: My humble work isn't done, so take some Lantern Dew for now. You'll get the first copy.
风车匠，话极短，常用“嗯”“得修”“能用”，三句不离榫卯和木头，夸人只说“行”。: A windmill maker of very few words: “Mm,” “Needs fixing,” “It'll do.” Always on joinery and wood; his only praise is “Good.”
让风车丘上十二架风车重新一起转起来。: Get all twelve windmills on Windmill Hill turning together again.
风车丘，十二架。现在转的，一架。: Windmill Hill. Twelve mills. Turning now: one.
其余的，叶片让蚀雾泡烂了。得修。一架一架修。: The rest, the Blight rotted their blades. Needs fixing. One mill at a time.
你那岛缺个工坊。图纸，拿着。别弄丢。: Your isle needs a workshop. Blueprint. Take it. Don't lose it.
这个榫头，是我师父在旧大地上削的。从大水里捞上来的。: This tenon. My master carved it on the Old Land. Fished it out of the great flood.
他说，好榫不用钉子，风越大咬得越紧。: He said a good joint needs no nails. The harder the wind, the tighter it holds.
我嘴笨。这本书，雷天用。给你。: I'm no talker. This book. For thunder days. Yours.
雾散了。第十二架，昨天装好的。: Fog's gone. Number twelve went up yesterday.
十二架一起转，声音……像我小时候听过的打谷场。: Twelve turning at once. Sounds like... the threshing floor when I was a boy.
苇音来吹了一曲。她说好听。嗯。这些铜锭，你拿去用。: Weiyin came and played a tune. Said it sounded nice. Mm. These Copper Ingots. Use them.
吹芦笛的人，说话轻轻的，爱用声音打比方，句尾常带“呢”，偶尔停顿用“……”。: A reed-flute player who speaks softly, describes things as sounds, ends lines gently, and often trails off with “...”
在风谷灯塔下，把旧大地那首只剩半截的曲子吹完整。: Play the half-remembered song of the Old Land in full, beneath Wind Valley Lighthouse.
芦湾的苇子，每一根被风吹过，声音都不一样呢。: The reeds of Reed Cove... each one sounds different when the wind passes through.
我挑了好久，才削出这支笛子。它的声音……像下过雨的早晨。: I searched so long before carving this flute. Its voice is... like a morning after rain.
你岛上若种些花，絮灵会更爱唱歌。花圃的图纸，送你。: If you grow flowers on your isle, the spirits will sing more. A flowerbed blueprint, for you.
我娘教过我一首曲子，旧大地上的。可我只记得前半首。: My mother taught me a song from the Old Land. But I only remember the first half.
在回音谷吹，山会把它送回来。送回来的，也只有前半首呢。: In Echo Canyon, the hills send it back to me. But only the first half comes back, too.
这本书是我娘留下的……给会用它的人吧。: My mother left me this book... It should go to someone who can use it.
灯塔亮的那夜，我在塔下吹笛。风停了一下……然后，后半首自己来了。: The night the lighthouse lit, I played beneath it. The wind paused... then the second half just came.
也许它一直在，只是被雾盖住了呢。: Maybe it was there all along, only hidden by the fog.
老榫说好听。……他只会说这一个词。这些灯露，谢谢你听我说完。: Old Tenon said it was nice... it's the only word he knows. This Lantern Dew is for listening to me.
风从芦湾吹过来，把你也吹来了。坐。: Wind from Reed Cove. Blew you in with it. Sit.
来了。今日东北风，三级，适合串门。: You came. Northeast wind today, force three. Good for visiting.
你的云舟靠岸声我认得。进来。: I know the sound of your skiff docking. Come in.
我泡了茶。算准你这个时辰到。: Tea's made. I reckoned you'd arrive about now.
今天的航程，第一站是你。不错的一天。: First stop on today's route: you. A good day.
回去走低空，岚脊那边乱流多。: Fly low on the way back. Gust Ridge is all turbulence.
到家点一下提灯，我这儿看得见。: Flash your lantern when you're home. I can see it from here.
风谷的风不讲理。但有规律。: Wind Valley winds don't listen to reason. But they keep a pattern.
商队那会儿，一年走三千里。现在走三里，腿疼。: Caravan days, I covered a thousand miles a year. Now one mile and my legs ache.
飞鸢那孩子，风筝线比航线还乱。得教。: That Feiyuan. His kite strings are messier than any route. Needs teaching.
闻风那老头说风能写进书里。风写不进去，只能跟着走。: That old man Windward says wind can be put in books. It can't. You can only follow it.
年轻时我也怕雾。后来发现，怕也得往前开。: I feared fog when I was young. Then I learned: scared or not, you sail on.
我这辈子没迷过路。只走丢过人。……喝茶。: Never lost my way in my life. Only lost people. ...Drink your tea.
晴天。能见度二十里。适合看远处。: Sunny. Visibility seven miles. Good for looking far.
太阳好，航图拿出来晒晒，纸都潮了。: Good sun. Time to air the charts. The paper's gone damp.
下雨。风蛾翅膀沉，今天不出航。: Rain. Windmoth wings get heavy. No sailing today.
雨天适合补航图。你来得正好，帮我磨墨。: Rain's good for mending charts. Perfect timing. Grind the ink for me.
起风了。西风，五级。好风。: Wind's up. Westerly, force five. Good wind.
这种风，商队一天能走两百里。可惜。: Wind like this, the caravan could do seventy miles a day. Shame.
风大时我总想起出海那天。心还是会跳快一下。: Strong wind always takes me back to my first voyage. My heart still skips.
打雷。电鳐精神了，你离它远点。: Thunder. Voltray's all fired up. Keep your distance.
雷天别飞。别学飞鸢，上回差点让雷劈了风筝。: Don't fly in thunder. Don't copy Feiyuan. Last time lightning nearly got his kite.
起雾。提灯点足，别逞强。: Fog. Keep your lantern well lit. Don't push your luck.
雾里认路，看风，不看眼睛。记住。: In fog, find your way by the wind, not your eyes. Remember that.
每回起雾，我都在岸边多站一会儿。万一有船回来呢。: Every time fog rolls in, I stay on the shore a while longer. In case a boat comes back.
夜航？星星比灯塔准。今晚北斗清楚。: Night sailing? Stars beat lighthouses. The Dipper's clear tonight.
睡不着就出来认星星。我教你哪颗是领航星。: Can't sleep? Come learn the stars. I'll show you the guide star.
这么晚了还来。……好，我正好也不困。: Here this late. ...Fine. I'm not sleepy either.
提灯燃料……好东西。识货。: Lantern Fuel... good stuff. You know quality.
这成色，够我跑一趟远航。谢了。: Quality like this would last me a long voyage. Thanks.
你倒是比我当年的副手还懂我。: You know me better than my old first mate did.
正缺这个。记账上，回头还你个人情。: Just what I needed. I'll log it. I owe you one.
你送的，我就留着。: You gave it, so I'll keep it.
甜的？不吃。牙口不行了。: Sweet? No. My teeth can't take it.
果酱留给飞鸢吧。那小子嘴馋。: Save the jam for Feiyuan. That boy has a sweet tooth.
比一场。看看你的絮灵认不认风。: A match. Let's see if your spirits can read the wind.
手痒了？来。我的风蛾也该活动活动。: Itching for a fight? Come on. My Windmoth needs the exercise.
老规矩，输的人泡茶。: Usual rules. Loser makes the tea.
航线选对了，就赢了。你再看看风。: Pick the right course and you win. Watch the wind again.
这一局，你第三回合偏了航。下次记着。: This round, you went off course on turn three. Remember that.
输了。你比我想的稳。: I lost. You're steadier than I thought.
好。这一手换人，像个老领航。茶我泡。: Good. That swap was an old navigator's move. I'll make the tea.
有趟活。东西备齐，报酬照付。: Got a job. Bring the goods, you'll be paid.
帮我凑点东西，我要去鸢野补一段航线。: Gather some things for me. I'm off to Kite Fields to mend a stretch of route.
货齐了。准时。这是报酬。: Cargo's complete. On time. Here's your pay.
你办事，我放心。多给你一点，别推。: I trust your work. A little extra. Don't argue.
路过。看看你的码头修得牢不牢。: Passing by. Checking your dock's built solid.
你岛的位置好，逆风能停，顺风能走。: Your isle's well placed. Shelter in a headwind, easy off in a tailwind.
来看看你。没别的事。……真的没别的事。: Came to see you. Nothing else. ...Really, nothing else.
小岛，靠着芦湾。以前商队的歇脚站。: Small isle off Reed Cove. Used to be the caravan's rest stop.
那根桅杆是老船上拆的。我舍不得扔。: That mast came off an old boat. Couldn't bear to toss it.
岛上每块木板都走过三千里。比我还老。: Every plank on this isle has traveled a thousand miles. Older than me.
咦？你是新来的守岛人吗？你会放风筝吗？: Huh? Are you the new Islekeeper? Can you fly a kite?
嘿！你好你好！我叫飞鸢，风谷放风筝第一名！: Hey! Hi hi! I'm Feiyuan, Wind Valley's number one kite flyer!
你来啦！快看快看，我又做了个新的！: You're here! Look look, I made another new one!
“慢吞吞”来了！……这是我给你起的外号，嘿嘿。: “Slowpoke” is here! ...That's my nickname for you, hehe.
我就知道是你！鸢羽老远就认出你的云舟了！: I knew it was you! Kitewing spotted your skiff from miles away!
你今天要陪我玩一整天！说好了的！: You're playing with me all day today! You promised!
拜拜！下次带好吃的来！: Bye bye! Bring snacks next time!
这么快就走？……那明天再来哦！: Leaving already? ...Then come back tomorrow, okay?
走吧走吧，我站在岛边放风筝送你！你回头看！: Go on, go on, I'll fly a kite from the edge to see you off! Look back!
鸢野的风是全风谷最好的！我说的！: Kite Fields has the best wind in all Wind Valley! I said so!
我的葵盘叫“小太阳”，它晒饱了会转圈圈！: My Sunplate is called “Little Sun”! When it's full of sunshine it spins around!
罗盘婆又说我的风筝线乱。明明是风乱！: Granny Compass says my kite strings are messy again. It's the wind that's messy!
岚姐说她放风筝比我厉害。我不信！下次比！: Sis Lan says she flies kites better than me. No way! We're having a contest!
我没见过旧大地。罗盘婆说那里的地是不会飘的。好怪哦。: I've never seen the Old Land. Granny Compass says the ground there doesn't float. So weird.
其实我晚上会想我爹娘。……你别告诉罗盘婆。: Sometimes at night I miss my mom and dad. ...Don't tell Granny Compass.
大太阳！小太阳也出来晒啦！: Big sun! Little Sun's out sunbathing too!
晴天没风，风筝飞不动……我就躺着看云，嘿嘿。: Sunny and no wind, kites won't fly... so I lie down and watch clouds, hehe.
下雨了，风筝纸会湿……好无聊啊。: It's raining, the kite paper'll get wet... so boring.
雨天我在屋里糊风筝！你要不要也糊一个？: On rainy days I glue kites indoors! Wanna make one too?
起风了！！快快快，风筝拿出来！: Wind's up!! Quick quick quick, get the kites!
这风超棒！今天能飞到岚脊那么高！: This wind is super great! Today I can fly as high as Gust Ridge!
这么好的风，你陪我放吧？线给你拿一会儿！: Wind this good, fly with me? You can hold the string for a bit!
雷天不能放风筝，罗盘婆会骂人的。: No kites in thunder, or Granny Compass will yell.
打雷的时候……你能在这儿待一会儿吗？就一会儿。: While it's thundering... can you stay here a bit? Just a bit.
起雾了，看不见风筝啦。: It's foggy, I can't see my kite.
雾天我不放风筝了。上回的线收回来黑黑的。: I don't fly kites in fog anymore. Last time the string came back all black.
这么晚？我在偷偷放夜风筝，上面挂了小灯！: This late? I'm secretly flying a night kite with a little lamp on it!
你看你看，那颗星星像不像风筝？: Look look, doesn't that star look like a kite?
晚上有你在就不怕了。……我本来也不怕！: With you here, night's not scary. ...Not that I was scared!
哇！风铃果！你怎么知道我最喜欢这个！: Whoa! Windbell Fruit! How'd you know it's my favorite!
超好吃！你是全云海最好的守岛人！: Super yummy! You're the best Islekeeper in the whole Cloudsea!
你对我太好了吧……我要给你做一只专门的风筝！: You're way too nice to me... I'm gonna make a kite just for you!
嘿嘿，这个好，我拿去给鸢羽也尝尝。: Hehe, this is good, I'll let Kitewing have a taste too.
我不知道这个能干嘛，不过你送的我就留着！: No idea what it's for, but you gave it to me, so I'm keeping it!
石头？好重……又不能放上天。: A rock? So heavy... and it can't even fly.
你又拿石头逗我！我才不上当！: You're teasing me with rocks again! Not falling for it!
我们来比一场吧！我的鸢羽超快的！: Let's have a match! My Kitewing is super fast!
再来再来！这次我想了一个超厉害的招！: Again again! I thought up a super awesome move this time!
跟你比最好玩了！输了也好玩！: Battling you is the most fun! Even losing is fun!
耶！我赢啦！我要告诉岚姐！: Yay! I won! I'm telling Sis Lan!
嘿嘿，你是不是让着我了？不许让！: Hehe, did you go easy on me? No going easy!
呜……输了。你好厉害哦。: Waah... I lost. You're so good.
不算不算！……好吧，算。你教我那一招好不好？: Doesn't count! ...Okay, it counts. Will you teach me that move?
我要做新风筝！你能帮我找点材料吗？: I'm making a new kite! Can you help me find some materials?
帮帮我嘛！这次的风筝超大，材料不够啦！: Help me, pleeease! This kite is super huge and I'm out of materials!
谢谢你！这是我攒的云贝！: Thank you! These are the shells I saved up!
你最好了！风筝做好第一个给你看！: You're the best! You'll be the first to see the kite when it's done!
我来找你玩啦！你的岛风大不大？: I came to play! Is it windy on your isle?
你家絮灵好可爱！能借我玩一会儿吗？: Your spirits are so cute! Can I play with them for a bit?
我偷偷跑出来的！罗盘婆不知道！嘘——: I snuck out! Granny Compass doesn't know! Shhh—
我的岛在鸢野边上，有好多好多风筝！: My isle's at the edge of Kite Fields, with lots and lots of kites!
屋顶上挂的是失败的风筝。一共四十三只，嘿嘿。: The ones on the roof are my failed kites. Forty-three of them, hehe.
这岛是罗盘婆帮我搭的。她嘴上凶，其实最好了。: Granny Compass helped me build this isle. She sounds grumpy, but she's the best.
哦？有客。在下闻风，记风向的。请坐。: Oh? A guest. I am Windward, recorder of winds. Do sit.
新任守岛人？幸会。容我先把这条风记完。: The new Islekeeper? A pleasure. Allow me to finish logging this wind first.
你来了。今日辰时风向偏东七度，与你的来向一致，妙哉。: You've come. This morning the wind ran seven degrees east, matching your approach. Marvelous.
正想找人说说话。坐，坐，茶还温着。: I was just wishing for someone to talk to. Sit, sit, the tea's still warm.
啊，是你。我在《风志》里给你单列了一页，嘿。: Ah, it's you. I've given you a page of your own in the Wind Annals, heh.
老朽今日精神好，大约是因为你要来。: This old man feels spry today. Likely because you were coming.
请慢走。岚脊风急，留神。: Safe travels. Gust Ridge winds are fierce, so take care.
慢走。下回来，我给你讲第四十卷，很有趣的。: Safe travels. Next time I'll tell you about Volume 40. It's quite fascinating.
去吧去吧。路上看见奇怪的风，记得告诉我。: Off you go. If you meet any odd winds on the way, do tell me.
风谷一年有风之日三百零九天。剩下的，是我数漏了。: Wind Valley has 309 windy days a year. The rest are ones I missed counting.
风蛾翅上的鳞粉，顺风时会发亮。这在第十二卷有记。: Windmoth wing scales shimmer in a tailwind. It's recorded in Volume 12.
罗盘那老太婆说风不能写进书里。荒谬！我写了九十七卷！: That old Compass woman says wind can't go in books. Absurd! I've written ninety-seven volumes!
苇音的笛声能测风速。我比对过，误差不过一成。: Weiyin's flute can measure wind speed. I've compared. Within ten percent.
我年轻时也想当领航员。晕船，作罢。此事勿外传。: I once wished to be a navigator. Seasickness ended that. Do keep it between us.
有时我怕，写到第一百卷，就没有理由再写下去了。: Sometimes I fear that once I reach Volume 100, I'll have no reason to keep writing.
晴，无云，风弱。此类天气，宜晒书。: Sunny, cloudless, light wind. Ideal weather for airing books.
晴日里我的回音鸮爱打盹，跟我一样。: On sunny days my Echowl loves to doze. Just like me.
雨天墨迹难干，今日只记，不誊。: Ink won't dry in the rain. Today I take notes, but make no fair copies.
雨声和风声混在一处，要细听才分得开。你听——: Rain and wind blend together. You must listen closely to tell them apart. Listen—
起风了！快，纸笔！: The wind's up! Quick, paper and brush!
此风自回音谷来，带着回响。第六十卷专门写过。: This wind comes from Echo Canyon, carrying echoes. Volume 60 covers it in full.
这样的大风天，我总觉得旧大地的风也混在里面。: On gusty days like this, I always feel the Old Land's winds are mixed in.
雷雨天，风向乱如麻。今日记录作废。: In a thunderstorm, the winds are a tangled mess. Today's records are void.
打雷时风会倒卷，有意思得很。……你别学我站在外头看。: In thunder the wind curls backward. Most interesting. ...Don't copy me and stand outside to watch.
雾里的风是有的，只是我的仪器看不见。: There is wind in the fog. My instruments simply can't see it.
雾天我反而爱出去走走。看不见的东西，才值得记。: Oddly, I like walking in the fog. What can't be seen is what's worth recording.
夜风最诚实，白日的喧闹都退了。: The night wind is the most honest. The day's bustle has all ebbed away.
夜里我的回音鸮会替我守着风标。你也来守一会儿？: At night my Echowl keeps watch on the weathervanes for me. Care to join the watch?
这么晚还陪我这个老头子。……多谢。: Keeping an old man company so late. ...Thank you.
雾晶！此物可以观雾之流向，正是我所求。: Mist Crystal! With this one may observe how fog flows. Exactly what I sought.
哎呀，你竟记得。我要把今日写进《风志》。: Oh my, you remembered. Today is going in the Wind Annals.
你待我这样好，老朽无以为报，只好多活几年写书了。: You're so kind to this old man. I've no way to repay you but to live longer and write more.
多谢，正合用。: Many thanks. Just what I needed.
好物，好物。我替我的书房谢谢你。: Fine thing, fine thing. My study thanks you.
哦，这是……收下了，多谢。: Oh, this is... I'll accept it. Thank you.
此物我不甚了解，回头查查第几卷有记载。: I'm not well versed in this. I'll check which volume mentions it.
铜矿？太沉，会让我的风标失准。: Copper ore? Too heavy. It'll throw off my weathervanes.
你又拿铜矿来。是不是想让我的风标失灵，好叫我歇着？: Copper ore again. Hoping to break my weathervanes so I'll take a rest?
对战？老朽不擅此道，不过也可一试。: A battle? This old man is no expert, but I'll give it a try.
我研究了你上回的出招顺序，来验证一下？: I've studied the order of your moves last time. Shall we test my theory?
来一局吧。输赢都记，第一百卷用得上。: Let's have a round. Win or lose, I'll record it. Volume 100 could use it.
侥幸，侥幸。全仗风向帮了我。: Sheer luck, sheer luck. The wind did all the work.
按我推算，你第二回合就该换人。下次试试。: By my reckoning, you should have swapped on turn two. Try it next time.
败了。你的絮灵比我的书更懂风。: I'm beaten. Your spirits understand the wind better than my books.
妙！这一手我没算到。容我记下来。: Marvelous! I didn't foresee that move. Let me write it down.
书房缺些东西，若有余裕，劳烦帮忙。: My study lacks a few things. If you can spare the time, I'd be grateful.
新的风标要做，材料不够。你帮帮老朽？: I'm building a new weathervane but I'm short on materials. Help an old man out?
多谢！区区心意，请收下。: Many thanks! A small token. Please accept it.
有你在，第九十八卷能早些动笔了。: With your help, I can start Volume 98 sooner.
冒昧来访。你岛上的风，我想记一记。: Forgive the intrusion. I'd like to record the winds on your isle.
你这岛上空的风很有个性，偏北三度，像你。: The wind over your isle has character. Three degrees north. Rather like you.
在书房坐久了，想来你这儿透透气。不打扰吧？: I've sat in my study too long and wanted some air here. Not a bother, I hope?
我住岚脊上，岛上有风标十二座。: I live on Gust Ridge. My isle has twelve weathervanes.
书房里九十七卷《风志》，一卷也没丢过。: Ninety-seven volumes of the Wind Annals in my study, and not one ever lost.
岛不大，书多，人少。你来了，便热闹些。: Small isle, many books, few people. With you here, it's livelier.
新守岛人？……风车丘。随便看。别碰叶片。: New Islekeeper? ...Windmill Hill. Look around. Don't touch the blades.
来了。等我，这颗榫还差一刀。: You came. Wait. This tenon needs one more cut.
嗯。坐。凳子我新打的，结实。: Mm. Sit. Made the stool new. It's sturdy.
你来了。……今天风车转得也顺。: You came. ...The mills are turning smooth today too.
走了？云舟的舵，回头我给你紧紧。: Leaving? I'll tighten your skiff's rudder later.
路上小心。到了……让苇音吹一声笛，我听得见。: Careful out there. When you arrive... have Weiyin play a note. I'll hear it.
苇哨蹲在风车上，叶片一转它就叫。挺好。: Reedwhistle perches on the windmill. Sings when the blades turn. Nice.
锤鸣帮我敲铜钉。比我准。: Hammerpeal drives copper nails for me. More accurate than me.
飞鸢那小子拿我的边角料做风筝。随他。: That Feiyuan uses my offcuts for kites. Let him.
我不会说话。苇音说，我修的风车替我说了。: I'm no talker. Weiyin says the mills I fix talk for me.
师父走的时候，最后一句是“榫要咬紧”。我记着。: My master's last words were “Make the joints hold tight.” I remember.
太阳好，上桐油。三遍。不能偷懒。: Good sun. Tung oil. Three coats. No cutting corners.
下雨。木头吃水。不开工。: Rain. Wood soaks it up. No work.
雨天我刨木头。屋里一股松香。你闻。: Rainy days I plane wood. The house smells of pine. Smell.
这风……三号那架有点抖。得修。: This wind... Number three's shaking a bit. Needs fixing.
大风天，我爱站在丘上听。十二架会一起响的，以后。: Windy days, I like listening from the hill. All twelve will sing together. Someday.
雷天，锤鸣兴奋，敲东西特别响。捂耳朵。: Thunder days, Hammerpeal gets excited and hammers extra loud. Cover your ears.
起雾。蚀雾泡过的木头，不能用了。: Fog. Wood soaked by the Blight is no good.
雾天别来风车丘。看不见叶片，危险。: Don't come to Windmill Hill in fog. Can't see the blades. Dangerous.
雾来的那年，我一夜拆了三架风车的叶片。全烂了。: The year the fog came, I took the blades off three mills in one night. All rotten.
夜里我听风车。哪架不对，听得出来。: At night I listen to the mills. I can hear which one's off.
睡不着？……坐着吧。我也不睡。: Can't sleep? ...Sit. I'm not sleeping either.
这纹理直。能做叶片骨。谢了。: Straight grain. Good for blade ribs. Thanks.
你挑的料，比我自己挑得还好。: You pick wood better than I do.
收下了。回头给你打个小物件。: I'll take it. I'll make you a little something later.
这个……我不懂。收着。: This... don't know it. I'll keep it.
雨莓……给苇音吧。她喜欢。: Rainberries... give them to Weiyin. She likes them.
比一场。输的人帮我扛木头。: A match. Loser hauls my lumber.
你絮灵的底子不错。缺打磨。: Your spirits have good grain. Need polishing.
这一手，严丝合缝。像好榫。: That move fit perfectly. Like a good joint.
缺料。帮个忙。给钱。: Short on stock. Help out. I'll pay.
修第几架都缺料。你帮我凑凑。: Every mill I fix, I'm short on stock. Help me gather some.
料好。多给你点。别推。: Good stock. Extra for you. Don't argue.
路过。看看你屋子。……梁有点歪。: Passing by. Checked your house. ...Beam's a bit crooked.
你那门轴响。我带了油。: Your door hinge squeaks. Brought oil.
来看看。顺手给你修了个篱笆。: Came by. Fixed your fence while I was at it.
最老那架是师父留的。我每年都给它换叶片。: The oldest one's from my master. I change its blades every year.
岛上东西，都是我一刀一刀削出来的。你随便坐。: Everything on this isle, I carved cut by cut. Sit anywhere.
你好呀……你的脚步声，像风吹过新苇呢。: Hello... your footsteps sound like wind through new reeds.
新来的守岛人？我叫苇音，在芦湾吹笛子的。: The new Islekeeper? I'm Weiyin. I play the flute at Reed Cove.
是你呀。苇哨刚刚叫了一声，我就猜到了呢。: Oh, it's you. Reedwhistle just sang a note, so I guessed.
来，坐芦苇边上。这里风声最好听。: Come, sit by the reeds. The wind sounds loveliest here.
你来了……今天的风，忽然就温柔了呢。: You came... and the wind suddenly turned gentle today.
我刚想吹首曲子，正好你来听。: I was just about to play a tune, and here you are to listen.
走的时候，我吹一段送你，好不好？: As you go, may I play you a little send-off?
路上听见笛声，就是我在想你们这些朋友呢。: If you hear a flute on your way, that's me thinking of my friends.
芦湾的苇子会唱歌的，只是要很安静才听得见。: The reeds of Reed Cove sing, but you have to be very quiet to hear.
湖纱喜欢趴在水面上，听我吹低音呢。: Lakeveil likes to lie on the water and listen to my low notes.
闻风先生说我的笛声能测风速……我只是在吹笛呀。: Mr. Windward says my flute can measure wind speed... I'm only playing, though.
老榫给我修过笛子。他手好巧……就是不爱说话呢。: Old Tenon once fixed my flute. He's so skilled... he just doesn't like to talk.
我娘以前说，曲子是用来记住人的。所以我一直吹。: My mother used to say songs are for remembering people. So I keep playing.
老榫说十二架风车修好那天，要我去吹一曲……我有点紧张呢。: Old Tenon wants me to play when all twelve mills are fixed... I'm a little nervous.
晴天呢，芦苇是金色的。: On sunny days, the reeds turn gold.
太阳好的时候，笛声会亮一点，你听得出来吗？: When the sun's out, the flute sounds a little brighter. Can you hear it?
下雨了……雨打在苇叶上，像很多小鼓。: It's raining... raindrops on the reed leaves, like lots of tiny drums.
我喜欢雨天。雨声会给我的笛子打拍子呢。: I love rainy days. The rain keeps time for my flute.
起风了，整片芦湾都在唱呢。: The wind's up, and all of Reed Cove is singing.
风太大的时候，我就不吹了，听风吹就好。: When the wind's too strong, I stop playing and just listen to it.
这样的风……我娘那首曲子的开头，就像这样。: Wind like this... it's how my mother's song begins.
打雷了……笛声会被盖住呢。: Thunder... it'll drown out the flute.
雷声其实也是一种调子，很低很低的。: Thunder is a melody too, really. A very, very low one.
起雾了……雾会把声音吞掉呢。: It's foggy... fog swallows sound, you know.
雾天在回音谷吹笛，回声会变得很远，很陌生。: Playing in Echo Canyon on foggy days, the echoes sound so distant, so strange.
雾天我总吹得很用力……好像这样，雾那边的人能听见。: On foggy days I play extra hard... as if someone beyond the fog might hear.
晚上好……夜里的笛声能传得很远呢。: Good evening... a flute carries far at night.
夜里吹给星星听。它们不会嫌我吹错。: At night I play for the stars. They don't mind my wrong notes.
你也睡不着吗？那我们一起听一会儿风吧。: Can't sleep either? Then let's listen to the wind together for a while.
雨莓……甜甜酸酸的，像一首小调呢。谢谢你。: Rainberries... sweet and tart, like a little tune. Thank you.
你记得我喜欢这个呀……心里像被风轻轻吹了一下。: You remembered I love these... it's like a soft breeze passed through my heart.
我要为这个写一段曲子。叫什么好呢……就叫你的名字吧。: I'll write a tune for this. What to call it... I'll name it after you.
谢谢你，我很喜欢呢。: Thank you, I really like it.
这个好，我拿去做点心，分给湖纱它们。: Lovely, I'll make snacks with it and share with Lakeveil and the others.
我先收着。也许哪天它会派上用场呢。: I'll keep it for now. Maybe someday it'll come in handy.
这个……硬硬的，有点吵呢。: This... it's hard, and a bit noisy.
石头和铜矿，还是给老榫吧。他会喜欢的。: Stones and copper ore... better give those to Old Tenon. He'll like them.
要比一场吗？我的苇哨会认真的。: Shall we have a match? My Reedwhistle will take it seriously.
来吧，就当合奏一曲。: Come, let's call it a duet.
和你对战，像二重奏呢。来吗？: Battling you feels like a duet. Shall we?
赢了……你的节奏有点乱呢。: I won... your rhythm was a little off.
你那一下急了半拍。不过很好听。: You rushed that one by half a beat. But it sounded lovely.
输了呢。你的絮灵很和你合拍。: I lost. Your spirits are so in tune with you.
这一曲是你领奏。我心服呢。: You led this piece. I gladly concede.
我想请你帮个小忙，可以吗？: Could I ask you a small favor?
有些东西我凑不齐……你愿意帮我吗？: There are a few things I can't gather... would you help me?
谢谢你，这是我的心意。: Thank you. This is from the heart.
你帮了我好多……我吹一首给你，当谢礼的一半。: You've helped me so much... I'll play you a song, as half my thanks.
打扰了……你岛上的风声，我想听一听。: Sorry to intrude... I'd like to hear the wind on your isle.
你岛上絮灵的叫声好热闹，像一支小乐队。: Your spirits are so lively, like a little band.
想你了，就来了。……我是说，想听你岛上的风。: I missed you, so I came. ...I mean, I missed the wind on your isle.
我住在芦湾，岛上全是芦苇呢。: I live at Reed Cove. My isle is all reeds.
屋里挂了十七支笛子，每一支声音都不一样。: Seventeen flutes hang in my house, and each has its own voice.
岛边那架小风车是老榫送的。它转的时候，会哼一个音呢。: The little windmill by the shore was from Old Tenon. It hums a note when it turns.
风蛾夜里认灯，商队以前拿它们当信标。: Windmoths find lights at night. The caravan used them as beacons.
鸢野的风一阵一阵，像喘气。别在那儿放低空。: Kite Fields wind comes in gasps, like breathing. Don't fly low there.
电鳐是我从电光滩那边的商路上捡的。当年它才巴掌大。: Found my Voltray on the trade route by Spark Strand. Palm-sized back then.
风谷灯塔要是亮了，回音谷那条线，我想再走一回。: If Wind Valley Lighthouse lights up, I want to run the Echo Canyon line once more.
风向变了。记下：午后转北。: Wind's shifted. Log it: turning north after noon.
夜里风稳。最适合想事情。: Steady wind at night. Best for thinking.
比一场。别拖，风要变了。: A match. Don't dawdle, the wind's turning.
东西我收了。报酬按航程算，一分不少。: Goods received. Paid by distance, every last shell.
你岛上的风标装歪了。我顺手扳正了。: Your weathervane was crooked. Straightened it while I was here.
岛上那面旧帆，是商队的旗。洗过很多回，还是那个颜色。: That old sail on the isle is the caravan's flag. Washed many times, same color still.
记着：雾里看风，不看眼睛。: Remember: in fog, trust the wind, not your eyes.
你知道吗？鸢絮长大了就叫鸢羽，鸢羽再长大……我还没见过！: Know what? Kitefluff grows into Kitewing, and Kitewing grows into... I've never seen!
我在风车丘偷偷放过风筝，被老榫叔瞪了一眼。超可怕。: I snuck a kite up on Windmill Hill and Uncle Tenon glared at me. Super scary.
苇音姐吹笛子的时候，我的风筝会飞得特别稳！真的！: When Sis Weiyin plays her flute, my kite flies extra steady! Really!
闻风爷爷说我是“风谷最大的变数”。这是夸我吧？: Grandpa Windward says I'm “Wind Valley's biggest wild card.” That's a compliment, right?
等雾散了，我要把风筝放到回音谷，让山也跟着喊！: When the fog's gone, I'm flying a kite in Echo Canyon so the hills shout too!
嘿！今天风怎么样？我已经试过三回了！: Hey! How's the wind today? I've tested it three times already!
这个能当风筝的配重！好主意吧？: This can be a kite weight! Great idea, right?
大饼风筝保佑！嘿嘿！: Pancake the kite has my back! Hehe!
你岛上的风比鸢野小一点点，适合放小风筝！: Your isle's wind is a teeny bit weaker than Kite Fields. Perfect for little kites!
我在岛边插了根竹竿，上面绑着风向袋，是罗盘婆教我的！: I stuck a bamboo pole at the edge with a windsock on it. Granny Compass taught me!
风有八向，我记十六向。罗盘只记八向。孰高孰低，一目了然。: Wind has eight directions; I log sixteen. Compass logs only eight. Who's better is plain to see.
苇哨鸣叫的音高，与风速成正比。此事我研究了十一年。: A Reedwhistle's pitch rises with wind speed. I've studied this for eleven years.
岚脊上那片雾，三年来没挪过一步。蹊跷。: That fog on Gust Ridge hasn't moved an inch in three years. Most peculiar.
风谷灯塔若重燃，岚脊的风应当会恢复成旧貌。我很想亲眼见。: If Wind Valley Lighthouse is rekindled, Gust Ridge winds should return to old ways. I long to see it.
罗盘那老太婆……其实她记的风，比我的书准。别告诉她。: That old Compass woman... her wind records are truer than my books. Don't tell her.
东南风转西南，不出半个时辰。你看着。: Southeast wind turning southwest within the hour. Just watch.
夜里的风标转得慢些，因为它也困了。……玩笑，玩笑。: Weathervanes turn slower at night because they're sleepy too. ...A jest, a jest.
此物第三十一卷提过一笔，今日得见实物，甚好。: Volume 31 mentions this in passing. To see the real thing at last. Splendid.
劳驾，我列了张单子。字小，你凑近看。: If you'd be so kind, I've made a list. Small print, so lean in close.
你这里的风，我已记入第九十七卷附录。: Your isle's winds are now in the appendix of Volume 97.
岛西那座最高的风标，是我亲手立的第一座。: The tallest weathervane, on the west side, was the first I ever raised myself.
叶片要顺纹。逆纹，三天就裂。: Blades go with the grain. Against it, they crack in three days.
风蛾爱停在风车轴上。暖和。: Windmoths like to rest on the mill axle. It's warm.
罗盘婆的船，是我年轻时修的。她还在用。: Granny Compass's boat. I repaired it when I was young. She still uses it.
苇音的笛子，裂过一回。我粘的。看不出来。: Weiyin's flute cracked once. I glued it. Can't tell.
十二架都转了，我就……歇一天。就一天。: When all twelve turn, I'll... take a day off. Just one.
嗯。手别闲着，递个刨子。: Mm. Don't stand idle. Hand me the plane.
絮灵跟木头一样，要养。: Spirits are like wood. They need tending.
看看你的风车。……叶片角度不对。我调了。: Checked your windmill. ...Blade angle was off. Fixed it.
丘顶那间棚子，是我睡觉的地方。离风车近。: That shed on the hilltop is where I sleep. Close to the mills.
回音谷会把笛声送回来，可送回来的，总比我吹的慢一点呢。: Echo Canyon sends my flute back, but it always returns a little slower than I played.
我的两只苇哨，一只高音，一只低音。合起来才是一首歌呢。: My two Reedwhistles, one high, one low. Only together do they make a song.
飞鸢那孩子总在我吹笛时放风筝，说这样飞得稳。好可爱呢。: Feiyuan always flies kites while I play, says it keeps them steady. So sweet.
岚脊上的雾里……我好像听见过谁在哼那首曲子。是我听错了吧。: In the fog on Gust Ridge... I think I heard someone humming that song. I must have misheard.
灯塔亮了以后，我想去灯塔下吹一整夜。你会来听吗？: Once the lighthouse is lit, I want to play beneath it all night. Will you come listen?
风在吹芦苇呢……你听，这是第三个音。: The wind's in the reeds... listen, that's the third note.
夜里的芦湾，安静得能听见絮灵做梦呢。: Reed Cove at night is so quiet you can hear the spirits dreaming.
谢谢……这个味道，让我想起一段调子。: Thank you... this taste reminds me of a melody.
想麻烦你一件小事……不急的，慢慢来就好。: May I trouble you with a small thing... no rush, take your time.
岛中间有块平石头，我常坐在那里吹笛呢。: There's a flat stone in the middle of my isle. I often sit there and play.
